change.title: Add inspect-only adapters for existing GitHub Skill packages
change.summary: Adds a non-executing, in-memory adapter for already-fetched GitHub ZIP bytes and a caller-asserted 40-hex claim. It reports a deterministic graph, labels provenance unverified, and cannot install or apply. Delimiter-sliced SKILL.md frontmatter is typed by serde-saphyr; unsupported YAML is Partial. Unsafe paths, special entries, duplicate or ASCII case-conflicting paths, markers, limits, and high compression ratios fail closed; retained non-ASCII paths are Partial. MCP manifest count, per-Skill allowed-tool declarations, graph nodes and edges, and all findings are bounded before they grow beyond the published limits. MCP JSON is opaque, and Plugin or unknown manifests are Unsupported. Consumer lockfiles for the Gateway and Desktop path dependencies are closed over the new source dependencies. No Gateway, Tauri, Agent, Science, process, network, or credential caller is added. The v1 bridge remains unchanged.

basis: the new public Rust entrypoint accepts a syntactically immutable caller-asserted GitHub source claim and already-fetched archive bytes, labels provenance unverified, and returns a versioned inspection result
the inspection result is not archive-to-commit provenance evidence and cannot be converted into an install or apply receipt
the implementation has no Gateway, Tauri invoke, Agent tool, install, apply, Science attachment, MCP process, network client, or credential-store caller
Gateway and Desktop consumer lockfiles are regenerated from their path dependency graphs so their source suites do not create post-suite lockfile drift
Focused Rust tests cover typed YAML, archive rejection, bounded MCP manifest/tool/graph/finding collections, unsupported manifests, deterministic hashes, and NOT-RUN effects
the existing version-1 bridge call and public tool surfaces remain bound by focused boundary tests and the canonical source gate
